queries.description: Show hourly average trend for a pollutant at a station over a date range
queries.sql: SELECT pa.Interval, AVG(pa.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, MAX(pa.Parametervalue) as MaxValue, MIN(pa.Parametervalue) as MinValue, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName, s.StationName FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pa.StationID = s.ID JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE pa.StationID = @stationId AND p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pa.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY pa.Interval, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName, s.StationName ORDER BY pa.Interval

queries.description: Show monthly average trend for a pollutant at a station
queries.sql: SELECT pam.Interval, AVG(pam.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, MAX(pam.Parametervalue) as MaxValue, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName, s.StationName FROM ParameterAveragesMonth pam JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pam.StationID = s.ID JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pam.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE pam.StationID = @stationId AND p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pam.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pam.Status = 1 GROUP BY pam.Interval, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName, s.StationName ORDER BY pam.Interval

queries.description: Find the worst air-quality month at a specific site in a given year — returns the month with highest avg AQI, the top pollutants with exceedance counts, and the peak single AQI reading. Uses ParameterAveragesMonth for monthly AQI, Parameters_Excedence_Values for thresholds, and ParameterAverages for peak hourly reading.
patterns: what drove the worst air quality month
which was the worst month for air quality
what made the worst month at
worst air quality in a month
queries.sql: WITH MonthlyAvg AS ( SELECT MONTH(pam.Interval) AS [Month], YEAR(pam.Interval) AS [Year], ROUND(AVG(CAST(pam.Parametervalue AS FLOAT)), 1) AS AvgAQI, MAX(CAST(pam.Parametervalue AS FLOAT)) AS MaxAQI FROM ParameterAveragesMonth pam JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pam.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pam.StationID = s.ID WHERE p.ParameterName = 'AQI Index' AND s.StationName LIKE '%' + @stationName + '%' AND YEAR(pam.Interval) = @year GROUP BY MONTH(pam.Interval), YEAR(pam.Interval) ), WorstMonth AS ( SELECT TOP 1 * FROM MonthlyAvg ORDER BY AvgAQI DESC ), Exceedances AS ( SELECT p.ParameterName, COUNT(*) AS ExceedanceCount FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pa.StationID = s.ID JOIN Parameters_Excedence_Values ev ON ev.Parameter = p.ParameterName AND ev.Interval = 24 WHERE s.StationName LIKE '%' + @stationName + '%' AND MONTH(pa.Interval) = (SELECT [Month] FROM WorstMonth) AND YEAR(pa.Interval) = @year AND pa.Parametervalue > ev.ExcedenceValue AND pa.Status = 1 AND p.ParameterName <> 'AQI Index' GROUP BY p.ParameterName ) SELECT wm.[Month], wm.[Year], wm.AvgAQI, wm.MaxAQI, e.ParameterName, e.ExceedanceCount FROM WorstMonth wm CROSS JOIN Exceedances e ORDER BY e.ExceedanceCount DESC

queries.description: Compare the current indoor AQI at a specific site with the nearest outdoor ambient (ArcGIS SDI) station. Fetches indoor AQI from GetAllSiteData, finds the nearest ambient station by coordinates, and returns both AQI values with distance.
patterns: what is the outdoor aqi near

queries.description: Find the stations with the highest pollutant readings over a period
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 10 s.StationName, p.ParameterName, AVG(pa.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, MAX(pa.Parametervalue) as PeakValue, u.UnitName FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pa.StationID = s.ID JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pa.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY s.StationName, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName ORDER BY AvgValue DESC

queries.description: Find the stations with the lowest (best) pollutant readings over a period
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 10 s.StationName, p.ParameterName, AVG(pa.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, MIN(pa.Parametervalue) as MinValue, u.UnitName FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pa.StationID = s.ID JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pa.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY s.StationName, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName ORDER BY AvgValue ASC

queries.description: Count how many readings exceeded the MOCCAE standard threshold for a pollutant at a station
queries.sql: SELECT s.StationName, p.ParameterName, ev.ExcedenceValue, u.UnitName, COUNT(*) as ExceedanceCount, MAX(pa.Parametervalue) as PeakValue FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pa.StationID = s.ID JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID JOIN Parameters_Excedence_Values ev ON ev.Parameter = p.ParameterName WHERE pa.StationID = @stationId AND p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pa.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pa.Parametervalue > ev.ExcedenceValue AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY s.StationName, p.ParameterName, ev.ExcedenceValue, u.UnitName

queries.description: Count exceedances across all stations for a pollutant — ranked worst to best
queries.sql: SELECT s.StationName, p.ParameterName, ev.ExcedenceValue, u.UnitName, COUNT(*) as ExceedanceCount, MAX(pa.Parametervalue) as PeakValue FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pa.StationID = s.ID JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID JOIN Parameters_Excedence_Values ev ON ev.Parameter = p.ParameterName WHERE p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pa.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pa.Parametervalue > ev.ExcedenceValue AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY s.StationName, p.ParameterName, ev.ExcedenceValue, u.UnitName ORDER BY ExceedanceCount DESC

queries.description: Rank all stations by average pollutant level
queries.sql: SELECT s.StationName, p.ParameterName, AVG(pa.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, MAX(pa.Parametervalue) as PeakValue, u.UnitName FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pa.StationID = s.ID JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pa.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY s.StationName, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName ORDER BY AvgValue DESC

queries.description: Hourly breakdown of a pollutant at a station on a specific date
queries.sql: SELECT DATEPART(HOUR, pa.Interval) as Hour, AVG(pa.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, MAX(pa.Parametervalue) as MaxValue, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE pa.StationID = @stationId AND p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND CAST(pa.Interval AS DATE) = @targetDate AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY DATEPART(HOUR, pa.Interval), p.ParameterName, u.UnitName ORDER BY Hour

queries.description: Find which hours of the day have the highest pollution levels on average
queries.sql: SELECT DATEPART(HOUR, pa.Interval) as Hour, AVG(pa.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, COUNT(*) as ReadingCount FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID WHERE pa.StationID = @stationId AND p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pa.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY DATEPART(HOUR, pa.Interval) ORDER BY AvgValue DESC

queries.description: Month-over-month comparison of a pollutant at a station
queries.sql: SELECT FORMAT(pam.Interval, 'yyyy-MM') as Month, AVG(pam.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, MAX(pam.Parametervalue) as MaxValue, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName FROM ParameterAveragesMonth pam JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pam.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE pam.StationID = @stationId AND p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pam.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pam.Status = 1 GROUP BY FORMAT(pam.Interval, 'yyyy-MM'), p.ParameterName, u.UnitName ORDER BY Month

queries.description: Worst pollutant readings across all stations in the past 7 days
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 20 s.StationName, p.ParameterName, AVG(pa.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, MAX(pa.Parametervalue) as PeakValue, u.UnitName FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pa.StationID = s.ID JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pa.Interval >= DATEADD(DAY, -7, GETUTCDATE()) AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY s.StationName, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName ORDER BY AvgValue DESC

queries.description: Temperature and humidity trend over time (historical chart) — only use when user asks for trend, chart, graph, or history
queries.sql: SELECT pa.Interval, p.ParameterName, AVG(pa.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, u.UnitName FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE pa.StationID = @stationId AND p.ParameterName IN ('Temperature', 'Humidity') AND pa.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY pa.Interval, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName ORDER BY pa.Interval, p.ParameterName

queries.description: CO2 and TVOC trend over time (historical chart) at a station — only use when user asks for trend, chart, graph, or history
queries.sql: SELECT pa.Interval, p.ParameterName, AVG(pa.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, u.UnitName FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE pa.StationID = @stationId AND p.ParameterName IN ('CO2', 'TVOC') AND pa.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY pa.Interval, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName ORDER BY pa.Interval, p.ParameterName

queries.description: Analyse how a specific indoor school site responded to an outdoor dust/sand event on a given date. Queries SiteParameterAverages (TypeID=14440) for the indoor site's 24-hour average of a pollutant (default PM10), and joins AmbientData with the nearest AmbientStation (by Haversine distance) for the outdoor 24-hour average of the same pollutant on that date. Returns indoor avg, outdoor avg, peak percent (indoor/outdoor), protection level, nearest ambient station name, and the date. Use when user asks how indoor air quality responded to a dust/sand storm event, or asks for indoor vs outdoor pollutant comparison on a specific date. Available ambient parameters: PM10, PM25, O3, SO2, NO2, CO, AQI.

indoor air quality respond during dust
indoor air quality at school respond
how did the school respond to dust
indoor air quality during dust event
indoor outdoor pm10 comparison on date
how did the building respond to dust
queries.sql: WITH IndoorSite AS ( SELECT TOP 1 s.ID AS SiteID, s.StationName, TRY_CAST(s.CoordinateY AS FLOAT) AS Longitude, TRY_CAST(s.CoordinateX AS FLOAT) AS Latitude FROM DMN_Stations s WHERE s.StationName LIKE '%' + @stationName + '%' AND s.Status = 1 AND s.CoordinateX IS NOT NULL AND s.CoordinateY IS NOT NULL AND s.CoordinateX <> '' AND s.CoordinateY <> '' AND TRY_CAST(s.CoordinateX AS FLOAT) IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CAST(s.CoordinateY AS FLOAT) IS NOT NULL ), IndoorAvg AS ( SELECT spa.StationID, ROUND(AVG(CAST(spa.Parametervalue AS FLOAT)), 1) AS IndoorAvg FROM SiteParameterAverages spa JOIN IndoorSite i ON spa.StationID = i.SiteID WHERE spa.TypeID = 14440 AND spa.ParameterName = @parameterName AND CAST(spa.Interval AS DATE) = TRY_CONVERT(DATE, @date, 23) GROUP BY spa.StationID ), NearestAmbient AS ( SELECT TOP 1 amb.Id AS AmbientStationID, amb.StationName AS AmbientStationName, ROUND(SQRT( ( (amb.Longitude - i.Longitude) * COS(RADIANS((amb.Latitude + i.Latitude) / 2.0)) * 111.32 ) * ( (amb.Longitude - i.Longitude) * COS(RADIANS((amb.Latitude + i.Latitude) / 2.0)) * 111.32 ) + ( (amb.Latitude - i.Latitude) * 111.32 ) * ( (amb.Latitude - i.Latitude) * 111.32 ) ), 2) AS Distance_km FROM AmbientStations amb CROSS JOIN IndoorSite i WHERE amb.Status = 'Active' AND amb.Latitude IS NOT NULL AND amb.Longitude IS NOT NULL ORDER BY Distance_km ), OutdoorAvg AS ( SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(ad.ParameterValue AS FLOAT)), 1) AS OutdoorAvg FROM AmbientData ad JOIN AmbientParameters ap ON ad.ParameterId = ap.Id JOIN NearestAmbient na ON ad.StationId = na.AmbientStationID WHERE ap.ParameterName = @parameterName AND TRY_CONVERT(DATE, ad.RecordedDate, 105) = TRY_CONVERT(DATE, @date, 23) ), OutdoorBaselineDailyMeans AS ( SELECT TRY_CONVERT(DATE, ad.RecordedDate, 105) AS ReadingDate, AVG(CAST(ad.ParameterValue AS FLOAT)) AS DailyMean FROM AmbientData ad JOIN AmbientParameters ap ON ad.ParameterId = ap.Id JOIN NearestAmbient na ON ad.StationId = na.AmbientStationID WHERE ap.ParameterName = @parameterName AND TRY_CONVERT(DATE, ad.RecordedDate, 105) >= DATEADD(DAY, -30, TRY_CONVERT(DATE, @date, 23)) AND TRY_CONVERT(DATE, ad.RecordedDate, 105) < TRY_CONVERT(DATE, @date, 23) GROUP BY TRY_CONVERT(DATE, ad.RecordedDate, 105) ), OutdoorBaseline AS ( SELECT ROUND(AVG(DailyMean), 1) AS OutdoorBaseline30 FROM OutdoorBaselineDailyMeans ), OutdoorBaselineByDay AS ( SELECT TRY_CONVERT(DATE, ad.RecordedDate, 105) AS ReadingDate, AVG(CAST(ad.ParameterValue AS FLOAT)) AS DailyOutdoor FROM AmbientData ad JOIN AmbientParameters ap ON ad.ParameterId = ap.Id JOIN NearestAmbient na ON ad.StationId = na.AmbientStationID WHERE ap.ParameterName = @parameterName AND TRY_CONVERT(DATE, ad.RecordedDate, 105) >= DATEADD(DAY, -14, TRY_CONVERT(DATE, @date, 23)) AND TRY_CONVERT(DATE, ad.RecordedDate, 105) < TRY_CONVERT(DATE, @date, 23) GROUP BY TRY_CONVERT(DATE, ad.RecordedDate, 105) ), BaselineRatio AS ( SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(spa.Parametervalue AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(obd.DailyOutdoor, 0)), 2) AS BaselineIORatio FROM SiteParameterAverages spa JOIN IndoorSite i ON spa.StationID = i.SiteID JOIN OutdoorBaselineByDay obd ON CAST(spa.Interval AS DATE) = obd.ReadingDate WHERE spa.TypeID = 14440 AND spa.ParameterName = @parameterName AND DATEPART(WEEKDAY, CAST(spa.Interval AS DATE)) NOT IN (1, 7) ) SELECT i.StationName AS IndoorSite, na.AmbientStationName AS NearestAmbientStation, na.Distance_km, TRY_CONVERT(DATE, @date, 23) AS EventDate, @parameterName AS Parameter, ia.IndoorAvg, oa.OutdoorAvg, ob.OutdoorBaseline30, br.BaselineIORatio, DATENAME(WEEKDAY, TRY_CONVERT(DATE, @date, 23)) AS DayOfWeek, CASE WHEN oa.OutdoorAvg > 0 THEN ROUND(ia.IndoorAvg / oa.OutdoorAvg, 2) ELSE NULL END AS IORatio FROM IndoorSite i LEFT JOIN IndoorAvg ia ON ia.StationID = i.SiteID CROSS JOIN NearestAmbient na LEFT JOIN OutdoorAvg oa ON 1=1 LEFT JOIN OutdoorBaseline ob ON 1=1 LEFT JOIN BaselineRatio br ON 1=1

queries.description: Analyse whether a pollutant (PM2.5, PM10, CO2, CO, NO2, SO2, O3, TVOC, etc.) at a residential indoor site is more likely from indoor sources (bakhoor, cooking, ventilation) or outdoor infiltration, over a date range. Compares the indoor 24-hour average from SiteParameterAverages (TypeID=14440) against the nearest outdoor ambient station from AmbientData, computing an Indoor/Outdoor ratio. Use when user asks about the source of any indoor pollutant, indoor vs outdoor comparison for any parameter, bakhoor or cooking vs outdoor dust for any pollutant, or what is causing elevated readings of any parameter at a residence.
patterns: is the pm2.5 more likely coming from indoors
is the pm10 more likely coming from indoors
is the co2 more likely coming from indoors
queries.sql: WITH IndoorSite AS ( SELECT TOP 1 s.ID AS SiteID, s.StationName, TRY_CAST(s.CoordinateY AS FLOAT) AS Longitude, TRY_CAST(s.CoordinateX AS FLOAT) AS Latitude FROM DMN_Stations s WHERE s.StationName LIKE '%' + @stationName + '%' AND s.Status = 1 AND s.CoordinateX IS NOT NULL AND s.CoordinateY IS NOT NULL AND s.CoordinateX <> '' AND s.CoordinateY <> '' AND TRY_CAST(s.CoordinateX AS FLOAT) IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CAST(s.CoordinateY AS FLOAT) IS NOT NULL ), IndoorAvg AS ( SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(spa.Parametervalue AS FLOAT)), 2) AS IndoorVal, COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(spa.Interval AS DATE)) AS DayCount FROM SiteParameterAverages spa JOIN IndoorSite i ON spa.StationID = i.SiteID WHERE spa.TypeID = 14440 AND spa.ParameterName = @parameterName AND CAST(spa.Interval AS DATE) BETWEEN TRY_CONVERT(DATE, @startDate, 23) AND TRY_CONVERT(DATE, @endDate, 23) ), NearestAmbient AS ( SELECT TOP 1 amb.Id AS AmbientStationID, amb.StationName AS AmbientStationName, ROUND(SQRT( ((amb.Longitude - i.Longitude) * COS(RADIANS((amb.Latitude + i.Latitude) / 2.0)) * 111.32) * ((amb.Longitude - i.Longitude) * COS(RADIANS((amb.Latitude + i.Latitude) / 2.0)) * 111.32) + ((amb.Latitude - i.Latitude) * 111.32) * ((amb.Latitude - i.Latitude) * 111.32) ), 2) AS Distance_km FROM AmbientStations amb CROSS JOIN IndoorSite i WHERE amb.Status = 'Active' AND amb.Latitude IS NOT NULL AND amb.Longitude IS NOT NULL ORDER BY Distance_km ), OutdoorDailyMeans AS ( SELECT TRY_CONVERT(DATE, ad.RecordedDate, 105) AS ReadingDate, ROUND(AVG(CAST(ad.ParameterValue AS FLOAT)), 2) AS DailyMean FROM AmbientData ad JOIN AmbientParameters ap ON ad.ParameterId = ap.Id JOIN NearestAmbient na ON ad.StationId = na.AmbientStationID WHERE ap.ParameterName = @parameterName AND TRY_CONVERT(DATE, ad.RecordedDate, 105) BETWEEN TRY_CONVERT(DATE, @startDate, 23) AND TRY_CONVERT(DATE, @endDate, 23) GROUP BY TRY_CONVERT(DATE, ad.RecordedDate, 105) ), OutdoorAvg AS ( SELECT ROUND(AVG(DailyMean), 2) AS OutdoorVal FROM OutdoorDailyMeans ) SELECT i.StationName AS ResidenceName, na.AmbientStationName AS NearestAmbientStation, na.Distance_km, @parameterName AS Parameter, TRY_CONVERT(DATE, @startDate, 23) AS PeriodStart, TRY_CONVERT(DATE, @endDate, 23) AS PeriodEnd, ia.DayCount, ia.IndoorVal, oa.OutdoorVal, CASE WHEN oa.OutdoorVal > 0 THEN ROUND(ia.IndoorVal / oa.OutdoorVal, 2) ELSE NULL END AS IORatio FROM IndoorSite i LEFT JOIN IndoorAvg ia ON 1=1 CROSS JOIN NearestAmbient na LEFT JOIN OutdoorAvg oa ON 1=1
